description: Earnings premium of a degree salary over a no degree baseline salary, both growing at the same annual raise rate, plus the net gain after degree cost, the break-even year, and the return multiple on cost. Use when the user asks whether a degree pays off versus the no-degree baseline. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive College ROI calculator.

annual_raise_pct.description: Annual raise percent applied to both salaries; default 3.

baseline_salary.description: Starting yearly salary without the degree in USD.

starting_salary.description: Starting yearly salary with the degree in USD.
